class models.deep.attention.attention_net.AttentionNetwork(input_dim: int, d_model: int = 128, num_layers: int = 4, num_heads: int = 8, d_ff: int = 512, output_dim: int = 10, dropout: float = 0.1, max_seq_len: int = 1000, output_type: Literal['prediction', 'embedding'] = 'prediction')[source]¶

Bases: Module

Attention Network for sequence modeling.

A stack of attention blocks that process sequences using self-attention mechanisms.

Parameters:

  • input_dim – Input feature dimension

  • d_model – Model dimension

  • num_layers – Number of attention blocks

  • num_heads – Number of attention heads per block

  • d_ff – Feed-forward dimension

  • output_dim – Output dimension

  • dropout – Dropout probability

  • max_seq_len – Maximum sequence length (for positional encoding)

  • output_type – ‘prediction’ returns final output, ‘embedding’ returns features

class models.deep.attention.attention_net.ScaledDotProductAttention(dropout: float = 0.1)[source]¶

Bases: Module

Scaled Dot-Product Attention.

Attention(Q, K, V) = softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d_k)) V

Parameters:

dropout – Dropout probability for attention weights

Module contents¶

Attention Mechanisms and Transformers.

Custom attention implementations: - AttentionNetwork (Generic Attention mechanism) - NSTransformer (Non-Stationary Transformer)
